desc_en: The Vertiv ER22010-T is a 220Vdc/10A high-voltage DC switch-mode rectifier module engineered for utility substations, power plants, and HVDC distribution systems. Utilizing advanced resonant soft-switching technology, it delivers >94% peak efficiency, hot-swappable reliability, and comprehensive electrical protection.

Digital Control & Hot-Swap: Full live hot-swap replacement with autonomous CAN bus current sharing (imbalance < 3%).
Wide AC Grid Resilience: Delivers full continuous output under rigorous 323Vac to 475Vac input fluctuations.

faqs.q_zh: 维谛 ER22010-T 模块面板报黄灯闪烁通常是什么原因？
faqs.a_zh: 黄灯闪烁一般代表模块处于通信中断告警或输入过欠压欠载限额状态。建议首先检查背板插针 CAN 总线接触状态，以及上位机监控模块（如 PSM 系列）波特率设置是否匹配。
faqs.q_en: What causes the ER22010-T front panel amber indicator to flash?
faqs.a_en: A flashing amber LED typically indicates a CAN communication loss or an AC input voltage derating condition. Verify rear backplane pin seating and supervisory baud rate settings.

faqs.q_zh: ER22010-T 能否与 ER22020-T 模块混插在同一电源插框内使用？
faqs.a_zh: 两者的物理尺寸和引脚定义完全兼容，但在同一直流母线并机时，必须通过主控单元开启按比例自主均流算法，否则大电流工况下可能引起负荷分配不均。
faqs.q_en: Can ER22010-T and ER22020-T modules be mixed in the same subrack?
faqs.a_en: Physical dimensions and backplanes are identical. When paralleled on the same DC bus, proportional current-sharing must be configured in the controller to prevent load imbalance.

Powered by full DSP digital control and LLC resonant conversion, it provides industry-leading electrical stability across extreme temperatures.

faqs.q_zh: ER22020-T 出现输出过压锁死后如何进行硬件复位？
faqs.a_zh: 输出过压锁死为保护蓄电池的硬件自锁行为。必须完全断开三相交流输入断路器，等待模块面板 LED 全部熄灭 30 秒后重新合闸复位。
faqs.q_en: How do I reset an ER22020-T module after an output overvoltage lockout?
faqs.a_en: Overvoltage lockout is an autonomous hardware latch to safeguard batteries. Disconnect the 3-phase AC input breaker completely, wait 30 seconds until all LEDs extinguish, and re-energize.

faqs.q_zh: 多台 ER22020-T 并机时如何分配 CAN 通信地址？
faqs.a_zh: 模块支持免拨码自动分配地址或通过上位机系统软件分配。插框背板插槽具备位置识别线，插入后监控单元会自动识别并编组显示。
faqs.q_en: How are CAN addresses assigned when multiple ER22020-T modules run in parallel?
faqs.a_en: The modules feature slot-ID automatic addressing through backplane pin coding, allowing the master supervisory controller to automatically recognize and enumerate each rectifier.

faqs.q_zh: 维谛 MP2-220K 监控面板报“母线绝缘降低”告警时应如何排查？
faqs.a_zh: 首先查看面板显示的正极与负极对地电阻数值。若某一极电阻跌落至设定报警阈值（如 < 25kΩ），可通过装置的支路选线菜单依次巡检各用电回路，排查进水潮湿或电缆绝缘老化分支。
faqs.q_en: How do you troubleshoot a 'DC Bus Insulation Low' alarm on the MP2-220K?
faqs.a_en: Check the positive-to-ground and negative-to-ground resistance readings on screen. If either drops below threshold (e.g. < 25kΩ), engage the feeder scan function to locate damp or damaged cables.

faqs.q_zh: MP2-220K 能否替换旧版维谛 PSM-E 系列监控单元？
faqs.a_zh: 可以替换。MP2 系列兼容旧款整流模块（如 ER22010/22020 系列）的通信规约，但因机箱开孔尺寸可能存在差异，工程改造时需配合专用过渡挡板安装。
faqs.q_en: Can the MP2-220K replace legacy Vertiv PSM-E series monitoring units?
faqs.a_en: Yes. The MP2 series maintains full communication compatibility with legacy ER rectifiers. A matching panel adapter plate may be required due to minor cutout differences.

desc_en: The Vertiv RP1V2001 is a compact DIN-rail mounted power distribution telemetry module engineered for precision power distribution cabinets (PDC) and telecom DC frames. It features multi-channel high-precision AC/DC voltage/current analog acquisition and digital status inputs to track circuit breaker positions and fuse alarms in real time.

faqs.q_zh: 维谛 RP1V2001 采集到的分路电流出现数值漂移应如何校准？
faqs.a_zh: 电流漂移多由于配套闭口/开口霍尔传感器零点偏移导致。可通过上位机监控单元进入传感器校准模式，在支路无负载空载状态下执行一键零点去皮（Zero Offset）即可复原。
faqs.q_en: How do you calibrate current measurement drift on the RP1V2001?
faqs.a_en: Drift is typically caused by Hall sensor zero-point offset. Access the sensor calibration menu via the supervisory controller and perform a zero-offset calibration with the branch circuit completely unloaded.

faqs.q_zh: 该模块的 RS485 地址拨码开关在何处，如何设置波特率？
faqs.a_zh: 模块壳体侧面配备 8 位标准微型拨码开关（DIP Switch），前 6 位设定设备通信地址（1~63），后 2 位设定波特率（常用 9600bps 或 19200bps）。
faqs.q_en: Where is the RS485 address DIP switch located on the RP1V2001, and how is baud rate set?
faqs.a_en: An 8-position DIP switch is located on the side panel. Positions 1 to 6 define the Modbus address (1-63), while positions 7 and 8 select the communication baud rate (9600/19200bps).

faqs.q_zh: 台达 DPR4850C 模块红灯亮起通常代表什么故障？
faqs.a_zh: 红灯（Alarm）常亮通常代表输出过压锁死、模块内部过温保护或风扇严重堵转故障。建议检查机箱防尘网通风状态，断电冷却 10 分钟后重新插拔开机。
faqs.q_en: What does a solid red LED on the Delta DPR4850C indicate?
faqs.a_en: A solid red LED indicates an output overvoltage lockout, over-temperature protection, or a locked cooling fan. Inspect airflow intakes, allow 10 minutes to cool, and reseat the unit.

faqs.q_zh: DPR4850C 模块可以在没有台达监控系统（独立脱机）下工作吗？
faqs.a_zh: 完全可以。模块具备自主出厂默认稳压参数（脱机默认输出 -53.5Vdc 浮充电压），无需监控器指令也可在标准电源插框内作为独立稳压电源输出 50A 电流。
faqs.q_en: Can the DPR4850C operate standalone without a supervisory controller?
faqs.a_en: Yes. It possesses default autonomous regulation (factory set to -53.5Vdc float voltage). In standalone mode, it supplies full 50A current without requiring controller commands.

faqs.q_zh: 中兴 ZXD4000 (V5.0) 模块面板指示灯全灭是什么原因？
faqs.a_zh: 若指示灯全灭，首先检查插框后置交流输入断路器是否跳闸或插针松动。其次，模块内部交流输入高压熔丝（Fuse）在遭遇电网超强雷击浪涌时可能熔断，需断电用万用表排查输入端导通性。
faqs.q_en: What causes all front panel indicators on the ZTE ZXD4000 (V5.0) to stay dark?
faqs.a_en: Verify that the rear subrack AC input breaker has not tripped and that the blind-mate pins are firmly engaged. In severe lightning cases, the internal AC input fuse may have blown and should be continuity-tested.

faqs.q_zh: ZXD4000 模块能否在 ZTE ZXDU68 系列大型机柜内平滑混插？
faqs.a_zh: 完全兼容。ZXD4000 (V5.0) 是中兴大型室内电源机柜（如 ZXDU68 T601 / T901）的原装指定主力模块，系统监控器可自动识别并统筹参数控制。
faqs.q_en: Is the ZXD4000 compatible with ZTE ZXDU68 large cabinet systems?
faqs.a_en: Yes. The ZXD4000 (V5.0) is the factory-standard rectifier for high-capacity ZXDU68 cabinets (e.g. T601/T901), fully recognized by the CSU central controller.
